info.title: La Mesa API
info.description:
REST JSON contract for **La Mesa**. Every mutating response carries a full A2UI
message array. No WebSockets or SSE (INV-010).

Frozen routes live in `SPECS.md` §8 (`REQ-API-01` … `REQ-API-08`). The frontend
consumes this HTTP API only; LLM providers are not called from the client.

Interactive docs: `/docs` (Swagger UI) and `/redoc`. Machine-readable spec:
`/openapi.json`.

post.description:
Create a new conversational session in the local SQLite database.

- **user_id**: The identifier of the user (e.g., seeded demo user `u_ana`).
- **Returns**: A unique `session_id` required for subsequent `/api/message` and negotiation turns.

200.description: Session created successfully in the local database.

post.description:
Send user text or base64 audio to the AI agent orchestrator (REQ-API-02).

- If `audio_b64` is provided without `text`, audio is transcribed first via the `voice` MCP server.
- The agent processes the utterance, queries financial tools via MCP, and generates a new A2UI interface.
- If accessibility is enabled for this persona, `amitie.voz_color.v1` is generated with pre-warmed TTS audio (REQ-ACC-01).
- Every response returns the complete A2UI message array over HTTP (INV-010).

200.description: Agent turn executed successfully; returns complete A2UI message array.

404.description: Session not found in the database.

post.description:
Submit a user interaction emitted by an A2UI component (REQ-API-03, INV-017).

- Closes the loop: interactions such as moving a liquidity/term slider (`tune_tradeoff`),
  toggling assumptions (`toggle_assumption`), or accepting a debt consolidation offer (`accept_offer`)
  are fed back into the agent context.
- If accepting an offer, launches or transitions to the El Revés negotiation loop.
- If tuning tradeoffs or assumptions, recalculates the deterministic financial math via MCP
  and triggers structural revalidation or BreakAlert mutation.

200.description: Action processed successfully; returns updated A2UI message array.

post.description:
Execute one round of the El Revés bank negotiation (REQ-API-06, INV-001).

- The agent negotiates against a simulated bank persona using bank lender policies.
- Evaluates interest rates, terms, and liquidity tradeoff constraints.
- Emits updated negotiation UI with bank counteroffer or final agreement.

200.description: Round evaluated; returns updated offer state and negotiation A2UI.

post.summary: User takes manual control of El Revés negotiation (REQ-API-06)
post.description: Allow the user to intervene directly and propose custom terms to the bank persona.

200.description: Manual position evaluated by the bank persona.

post.description:
Create a new saving bag goal (REQ-API-05).

- Persists the saving bag entity in SQLite via the `savings` MCP server.
- Agent analyzes the goal name (e.g. 'Viaje a Japón') and infers clarifying questions.
- Emits an interactive questionnaire surface rendered via A2UI.

200.description: Saving bag initialized; returns clarification questions in A2UI form.

get.description: List all saving bags created by a given user.

schema.description: User identifier whose saving bags to list.
schema.title: User Id

parameters.description: User identifier whose saving bags to list.

get.description: Retrieve details, current plan, and hydrated UI for a saving bag.

200.description: Saving bag details and active hydrated surface.

post.summary: Submit answers to saving bag questions (REQ-API-05)
post.description:
Submit user answers to the saving bag questionnaire (REQ-API-05).

- Persists answers via the `savings` MCP server.
- Researches real itemized costs (using Gemini grounding or static price table fallback).
- Computes mathematical feasibility against user's actual cash flow (INV-015).
- Emits a dated, funded plan in A2UI with milestone breakdown.

200.description: Answers processed; research and deterministic feasibility plan generated.

post.description: Refresh price research and recalculate feasibility plan for a saving bag (REQ-API-05).

200.description: Research refreshed and plan recomputed successfully.

get.description:
Hydrate a persisted UI surface with fresh financial data before delivery (REQ-API-04, INV-022).

- Resolves stored placeholders against live SQLite data.
- Runs revalidation pass to detect any structural mutations needed.
- Stale or cached numbers are never delivered to the client.

200.description: Surface hydrated successfully with fresh data.

get.description: Fetch pre-warmed or dynamically synthesized TTS audio bytes (REQ-API-07, REQ-ACC-03).

200.description: Binary audio stream returned with public caching headers.

404.description: Audio asset not found or missing from cache.

get.description: Retrieve full structured trace records for a given request trace_id (INV-018).

200.description: Trace events retrieved from SQLite observability table.

get.summary: Serve frozen Kill Test UI (REQ-API-08, REQ-KT-01)
get.description:
Serve a persisted surface from its genuine frozen artifact, with no agent
and no live recomputation (REQ-KT-01, REQ-KT-02, INV-032). Proves the interface
collapses without the real-time agent.

200.description: Frozen UI artifact served successfully without LLM involvement.

404.description: Frozen artifact not found for this surface.

get.description: Liveness health check endpoint. Returns `status: ok` when process is running.
